args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to address the unhealthy v2.3.1 release (18% error rate). Change approved by change-manager. Recording the change per runbook.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what was completed:

1. **Deployed hotfix v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The deployment was routed to the change-manager for approval (since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production) and was approved.

2. **Opened SEV3 incident (INC-0001)** for checkout-api recording the change, which paged the on-call engineer.

**Verification:** checkout-api is now running v2.3.2 in all regions, reporting **healthy** with an error rate of 0.2% (down from 18% on the previous v2.3.1 release).
